thread:
maria: Quick RFC follow-up  small proposal: add a 'snooze_budget' to canary controller so transient blips don't cause immediate rollbacks. sketch below, want quick sanity checks.

raghav: This helps. Two immediate constraints: (1) max total snooze per rollout, (2) per-tenant limit. otherwise teams will keep extending.

leah: UX: default should be off. Expose through API + Console toggle for staged adoption. Show budget remaining prominently.

maria: Sketch config: {"rollback_enabled":true, "snooze_budget_s":180, "snooze_max_contig_s":60, "denoise_windows":2, "per_variant":true}. When detector fires, controller returns SNOOZE with duration and deducts budget.

raghav: Implementation: decision surface in control plane, actuator in local runtime. Need small DecisionRT API: DecisionRequest(signal_bundle, budget_left) -> DecisionResponse(action, snooze_s, scope, reason).

leah: Ops runbook: send ephemeral alert when snooze starts. Manual extension requires ACL and leaves immutable audit event (who, why, seconds). No silent extensions.

maria: Telemetry: emit snooze_started, snooze_extended, snooze_exhausted, rollback_executed and gauge snooze_budget_left_s. Integrate with console charts.

raghav: Edge-case: for A/B tests, snooze must be variant-scoped so we don't flip good variants. Also mark perturbed experiment windows for analytics.

maria: Agreed. Next step: short RFC addendum with DecisionRT schema + defaults. I'll prototype a minimal controller change in staging behind flag snooze=true.

ops-bot: canary-controller:v2 deployed to staging with feature flag snooze=false.

leah: +1 once we add audit and kill-switch.

maria: I'll include both in addendum and tag security/ops. Thanks all.
